outcome: formula use for breastfed babies in hospital
cohort: The cohort consisted of 339,854 liveborn singleton births at >= 37 weeks' gestation in Victoria, Australia from 2009-2013.
finding: Maternal primary postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) and severe PPH were associated with a lower likelihood of exclusive breastfeeding at discharge and an increased likelihood of formula use for breastfed babies in the hospital.
